messages:
Ellen Park: Quick thread: we need a compact ISV onboarding playbook for connectors (LangChain/LlamaIndex + orchestrators/gateways). Focus: marketplace fields, CI smoke, HW matrix, announcement steps. Volunteers?
Rohit Mehra: Ill own CI + smoke tests. Plan: GH Action that runs end-to-end against staging gateway. 3 workdays.
Zoe Lin: Ill draft marketplace metadata + quickstart (include streaming + tool-call example). Need logos and repo links from partners.
Hugo Alvarez: Ill take HW compatibility and perf baselines (A100/H100 + 48GB card). send me partner sample workloads.
Ellen Park: Great. Minimal checklist items to include in playbook: owner, marketplace template, smoke test matrix, HW runbook, security sign-off, announcement owner + embargo.
Rohit Mehra: Smoke tests (short):
- e2e: orchestrator -> gateway -> runtime success
- streaming: partial output + cancel handling
- fallback: hosted model when local fails
- perf smoke: p95 under target for small requests
Zoe Lin: Marketplace fields draft: display name, short desc, long desc, supported infra, quickstart link, repo, pricing hint, regions, logos, partner contact, compliance badges. Will post template link.
Hugo Alvarez: HW runs: 8k chat, 16k summarize, quantized vs fp16 accuracy delta. Capture mem & kv-cache growth.
Marketing Bot: Created ticket: https://git.internal/rw/issues/9014 (isv-onboard-playbook) :spiral_calendar:
Ellen Park: Timeline suggestion: Week 0 kickoff, Week 1 smoke + quickstart, Week 2 perf + security, Week 3 sign-off + marketing assets. Target soft-launch window: Jun 10.
Rohit Mehra: I'll open PR with GH Action and tag @Hugo for perf hooks.
Zoe Lin: Posting marketplace template in 2h.
Hugo Alvarez: Requesting partner workloads now. ETA 4d.
Ellen Park: Recap: Rohit (CI, 3d), Zoe (marketplace + quickstart, 4d), Hugo (HW & perf, 7d), Ellen (announcement + legal loop). Ping me for blockers. :rocket:
